notes.title: Anomaly President - Gameplay Overview
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=_2iNiVAg8Mg;full][/previewyoutube]

In this gameplay video, we wanted to showcase some of the unique features of Anomaly President. You’ll get to see a variety of weapons you can use in combat, anomaly powers with different abilities, adorable Fluffies that will assist you in every situation, and your bus — your presidential campaign home that you can customize with your own choices.

To achieve your goal on the road to the presidency, you'll have to use every means available. Sometimes you’ll rely on your arsenal to defeat a giant enemy; other times, you’ll gather votes by putting on a dance show in front of your supporters.

If you'd like to stay updated and support us, don't forget to add Anomaly President to your wishlist.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3156330/

notes.title: Anomaly President - New Weapon: Kusarigama!
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=0wLgp41zjpQ;full][/previewyoutube]

Introducing our new weapon: Kusarigama!

Previously, we asked you which weapon you’d like to see in the Anomaly President, and from the feedback we received, we decided that Kusarigama would be a perfect fit!

Currently, we have four melee weapons in the game: “Sword, Staff, Fists, and Kusarigama.” By the time we launch Early Access, we plan to increase this number to eight.

Each weapon has its own unique attacks. Our goal is to make every weapon we add to the game excel in different areas.

For example, the Kusarigama is great for crowd control, making it easier to handle groups of enemies compared to other weapons. Its extended reach is especially helpful when you want to keep enemies at a distance. However, if we’re talking one-on-one combat, the Kusarigama can feel a bit sluggish. But don’t worry—you can carry two different weapons at the same time in the game. You can control a crowd with the Kusarigama and then switch to your sword for close combat. Which two weapons you use will be entirely up to the player!

Of course, weapons aren’t the only way to take on enemies. At least 20 different anomaly powers will be available in the game. You’ll be able to develop these powers to suit your playstyle, adding elemental damage to take them to the next level. For instance, the “dual-directional shooting” ability briefly shown in the video is an anomaly power in the “Range Weapon Attack” category. Powers like this, and many more, will accompany you throughout the game.

And then there’s our Fluffy army, which we haven’t even shown yet! These adorable Fluffies will assist us in battle and amplify our power in fantastical ways. Whether it’s a Fluffy that devours enemies, unleashes lightning, or rains bullets, countless types of Fluffies are waiting for us!

We have so much more to show, and we’re incredibly excited about all of it. We can’t wait to share it with you when the time comes!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3156330/

notes.title: Anomaly President - Our Next Journey After Anomaly Agent
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=YePGFxedZ6c;full][/previewyoutube]
We're excited to share our second project: Anomaly President.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44030674/298ea670a95089b3368a962406848e737d4c1137.gif[/img]

Anomaly President is here with its unique presidential rogue-like gameplay where you can destroy your enemies in the craziest ways!

Take on the mission to overthrow a president pushing the world toward disaster. But fighting is not enough. To save the world, you must also run for presidency.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44030674/aea8dc8cb54910e5a20a7940ab7838c70fcd2a56.gif[/img]

Thank you all for the amazing support you've given us with Anomaly Agent. Your feedback means so much to us and is guiding our next steps in shaping what Anomaly President will become.

If you'd like to continue supporting us, you can wishlist Anomaly President.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3156330/

notes.title: Anomaly Agent - Free Major Update, Rogue Agent Mode, Available Now!
notes.content:
Anomaly Agent's Roguelike mode, Rogue Agent, is available now!

[previewyoutube=rIG3P4NO9mM;full][/previewyoutube]

We are thrilled by the interest you've shown in Anomaly Agent. Thanks to your support, we've had the chance to realize one of our dreams.

After releasing the game, we pondered how we could reciprocate this support. The idea came to us to create an additional mode for the game. We wanted to prepare a challenge mode that players who love the game and enjoy playing it could enter repeatedly and try out. Initially, this challenge mode was going to be about defeating waves of enemies in a simple manner. However, we decided to add some roguelike elements to make it more engaging and take it to a more enjoyable level.

In the end, you won't see entirely new things, but you'll notice that the existing elements of the game are presented in a different way.

We hope it's a mod you'll enjoy playing. Wishing you a lot of fun. Thanks again for your support.

notes.title: v.1.0.0.22 Hotfix
notes.content:
Due to an issue after the launch, we noticed that the "Treasure Hunter" achievement is not progressing as it should be for some players. After installing this update, when you open the game and reach the Main Menu, the achievement should be correctly updated on the Steam.

There are a total of 28 chests in the game. If you haven't deleted your game progress after opening all the chests, the achievement should unlock when you enter the game after the update.

notes.title: Anomaly Agent Arrives January 24!
notes.content:
Hello everyone, this is Enis from Phew Phew Games.

We've got some new details about Anomaly Agent! Our release date is confirmed! Hooraay! Finally! 

We're launching on January 24, 2024!

[previewyoutube=RsnX0SLCcX4;full][/previewyoutube]

Our original plan was to release the game in 2023. However, after the demo phase, we decided to tweak a few more things based on the feedback we received.

We had the chance to release the demo of our game during Steam Next Fest. About 40,000 people tried the demo and shared their feedback with us on social media. We're incredibly grateful for that. It was immensely beneficial for us. The positive feedback was truly motivating. 

The most complained-about aspect of the demo was what we focused on improving. Players wanted the enemies to be more aggressive and threatening, so we've reworked the movement sets, attack patterns, and speeds of all in-game enemies.

As a result, we found that enemies have significantly upgraded. They're providing a much tougher challenge now. We've also added new features for our protagonist. These new abilities will come in handy, especially when dealing with enemy groups.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44030674/8891e1433d11ed3867ea28cc1053e88ac257c41e.gif[/img]

We've introduced new combo moves. By combining these moves with special abilities, players can overcome tough enemy situations. Additionally, using environmental elements and utilizing dropped weapons remains a crucial aspect of the game.

Besides the action, we have fantastic music to accompany our gameplay. A total of 13 unique tracks were composed by Ali Barutcuoglu specifically for the game. The positive feedback we received for the musics made us extremely happy. Rest assured, you'll hear much more of these tracks in the full version.

Alongside these original tracks, we're also featuring 3 compositions by Berkan Cesur.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44030674/c80cacdb6be7f0ca3d9512ad3be4c77ecb548d71.gif[/img]

We aimed to create an adventure where people could have fun. You'll engage in conversations with various characters, earning different emotions from them. Yes, the game features an emotion-gaining system. The responses you give will earn certain emotions, which you can then spend on the upgrade screen.

Also we already have post-launch update plans. After the game is released, we'll be introducing a Hardcore New Game Plus mode and a special challenge mode, both of which will be offered to players at no cost.

We are extremely excited for you all to experience the full game. Hopefully, we've managed to create something enjoyable for you to play. See you on January 24th!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44030674/70f917fc4f0a9615abb96308fc6e57b58236d749.jpg[/img]
